TABLE.NAME: diagnosis
TABLE.COMMENT: Diagnosis activity instances (one clinical case per instance).

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: The course this activity belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The activity name.

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: The activity introduction.

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the intro field.

FIELD.NAME: casequestion
FIELD.COMMENT: The clinical case prompt shown to readers.

FIELD.NAME: correctdiagnosis
FIELD.COMMENT: The expected diagnosis, shown to readers when the outcome is revealed.

FIELD.NAME: revealtext
FIELD.COMMENT: The outcome explanation shown after the case is revealed.

FIELD.NAME: revealed
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the outcome has been revealed (0 or 1).

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: The maximum grade (points); 0 disables grading.

FIELD.NAME: completionsubmit
FIELD.COMMENT: Completion rule: require the student to submit a diagnosis (0 or 1).

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the instance was created.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the instance was last modified.

TABLE.NAME: diagnosis_submissions
TABLE.COMMENT: Reader-submitted diagnoses, one per user per instance.

FIELD.NAME: diagnosisid
FIELD.COMMENT: The diagnosis instance this submission belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who submitted the diagnosis.

FIELD.NAME: diagnosis
FIELD.COMMENT: The submitted diagnosis text.

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Points awarded by the teacher's marking (simple or advanced grading), or null when not yet marked.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the diagnosis was first submitted.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the diagnosis was last updated.

TABLE.NAME: diagnosis_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: Reader questions on a case and the teacher's answers.

FIELD.NAME: diagnosisid
FIELD.COMMENT: The diagnosis instance this question belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who asked the question.

FIELD.NAME: question
FIELD.COMMENT: The question text.

FIELD.NAME: answer
FIELD.COMMENT: The answer text, or null while unanswered.

FIELD.NAME: answeredby
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who answered, or 0 while unanswered.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the question was asked.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the question or answer was last changed.

FIELD.NAME: timeanswered
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the question was answered, or 0 while unanswered.
